updates.title: Student visa application fee rises to AUD 2,000 (mock)
updates.body: From 1 Jan 2027 the student visa application fee rises to AUD 2,000 (mock figure). Lodge your application before then to pay today's fee.

updates.title: 485 graduate visa: age limit lowered to 35 (mock)
updates.body: You must be 35 or under when you apply for the Temporary Graduate visa, subclass 485 (mock rule). Plan your course length with this in mind.

updates.title: ECU International Scholarship: 20% off tuition (mock)
updates.body: 20% off tuition for the full course (mock) if you hold an offer for an ECU postgraduate course.

updates.title: UniSA Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship: 15% off tuition (mock)
updates.body: 15% off tuition for the full course (mock) for international students who start a UniSA course in 2027.

updates.title: UTS launches a Master of Artificial Intelligence for Feb 2027 (mock)
updates.body: A new two-year Master of Artificial Intelligence starts in February 2027 (mock). Applications open in November.

updates.title: Deakin adds a July intake for Business Analytics (mock)
updates.body: Business Analytics now starts in July as well as February (mock), so you can begin mid-year instead of waiting.

updates.title: Study Adelaide: AUD 2,500 relocation grant for new international students (mock)
updates.body: A one-off AUD 2,500 grant (mock) towards moving to Adelaide, for new international students at a South Australian institution.

updates.title: Australia Awards: full scholarships for students from Nepal (mock)
updates.body: Full tuition, return travel and a living allowance (mock) for students from Nepal starting a postgraduate course in 2028.
